messages:
elaine: Heads-up: planning a controlled bump of min replicas for the dedicated GPU pool `dedicated-gpu-rtx` tonight to absorb a planned PL test. Target change: min_replicas 2 -> 4. Keeping the rollout gradual and with smoke checks. Who can own deploy + watch?

sam: I can own the deploy window. Proposed time: Tue 2026-04-07 22:00 UTC. Will trigger a gradual increase (one node every 3 minutes) and run smoke jobs after each step.

miguel: Config diff I'll apply (k8s HPA override):
```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: dedicated-gpu-rtx-hpa
spec:
  minReplicas: 4  # bump from 2
  maxReplicas: 40
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: gpu_utilization
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 65
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300  # hysteresis to avoid thrash
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 60
```
I'll push this as a configmap change + rollout CA.

harper: Rollback plan? If we see latency > 150ms p50 or OOMs, revert steps: 1) abort further increases; 2) patch HPA back to minReplicas:2; 3) trigger immediate eviction of low-priority jobs. Command to revert quickly:
```
kubectl patch hpa dedicated-gpu-rtx-hpa -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}' --type=merge
```

deploy-bot: [CI] deploy-job-142 queued by sam. Estimated runtime 12m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: I'll run canary on slice-a first (traffic routed 5%). If green for 10m, advance to slice-b (25%). Final cut to 100% only after we pass all smoke suites.

elaine: I'll monitor Redwood Console (per-route latency + token cost) and keep a 30-min hold between major steps. Ping me in thread with timestamps for each step.

miguel: Smoke commands (can run from eng-tooling station):
```
# small-chat smoke
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"gpt-rtx-mini","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq '.duration,.error'

# embedding sanity
python infra/bench/embedding_check.py --pool dedicated-gpu-rtx --count 10
```

harper: Alerts to watch: infra/gpu-slice-oom (critical), infra/gpu-queue-latency (>500ms p95), and cost/committed-util-drop (>10% drop). If any fire, escalate to oncall@redwood and tag @elaine. Link to runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/gpu-bump (internal).

sam: After deploy I'll paste step timestamps here and results. Also leaving a short rollback snippet in the PR description. :thumbsup:

elaine: All set from infra side. One ask: keep burst_capacity unchanged for now to avoid unexpected preemption.

miguel: Acknowledged. I'll not touch burst_capacity. Will also add extra logging around pod eviction reasons for the next 2 hours.

deploy-bot: [CI] deploy-job-142 started by sam at 2181234560.

sam: Step1 done: minReplicas -> 3 applied at 2181234565, canary slice-a routed 5% traffic. Running smoke.

elaine: Observing metrics: p50 latency +2ms, token cost steady. No errors so far.

miguel: Smoke suite passed on slice-a. Proceeding to minReplicas -> 4 at 2181234580.

sam: Step2 done: minReplicas 4 applied. Advancing to slice-b 25% at 2181234585.

harper: Watching dashboards. No OOMs. Queue latency normal. :white_check_mark:

elaine: Great. Leaving hold until 2181234599 before final verification/readout.

sam: Final: all smoke checks green, will close PR and annotate deploy notes. Thanks everyone. :party:
